notes.title: v1.2.2 - Minor Update
notes.notes:
[list][*] Implemented a workaround for an engine-level bug that prevented launching in some scenarios where the user account includes spaces.
[*] Improved launch speed (essentially, the workaround involved forcing the download of certain files already decompressed, which were otherwise being decompressed at every launch).[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.0 - The Achievements Update
notes.notes:
I'm feeling a bit under the weather [i](cough, cough)[/i], so I'll keep this brief:

[b]- Achievements
- Juke Box
- Improved movement
- Some redesigned levels
- Skin descriptions
- Reworked endgame
- Many tweaks and bug fixes[/b]

[b][u]Regarding achievements[/u][/b]
Only achievements related to accumulated deaths before the update will activate automatically. If you don't want that to happen, reset your saved game before starting a new game to unlock them gradually one by one (beware, you'll lose all progress!).

[b][u]About the Juke Box[/u][/b]
I'm confident you'll get the hang of it after a few clicks.

[b][u]And the improved movement?[/u][/b]
Between frustration and fun, I'll always choose fun. I've made very subtle adjustments to the movement to benefit the player—nothing that significantly affects how we move, but it further combats the potential perception of failing due to control at any given moment. The changes should only be visibly appreciated by more seasoned players.

[b][u]Concerning the redesigned levels[/u][/b]
Some levels have been touched up or completely redesigned to enhance gameplay. I doubt you'll miss any; it only affected the most lackluster ones, which have now ended up in the limbo of discarded levels. (Will there ever be a periodic rotation of levels? Only if this gains traction beyond family and friends.)

[b][u]Skin descriptions?[/u][/b]
The descriptions should make it clear to the player (or at least give them a hint) about which skins imply higher or lower difficulty in the game.

[i]Have fun, I hope you enjoy![/i]

notes.title: v1.1.4 - Minor Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added the option for instant retry by quickly pressing the jump button three times after death*.
[*] Minor graphical tweaks.
[/list]

[i]* Some people have complained about the agonizingly long wait to retry after death. Fair enough, I get it. It seems some folks are just in a hurry to embrace digital doom repeatedly, showing no interest in a profound existential reflection. So, starting today, you can hit the jump button three times in rapid succession right after biting the virtual dust for an instant reincarnation. Happy retrying![/i]
